sentences.cn_text: 夏威夷末代君主莉莉乌欧卡拉尼女王于1897年写道：「古代夏威夷人是天文学家。」
sentences.en_text: “The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers,” wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii’s last reigning monarch, in 1897.

sentences.cn_text: 观星者曾是夏威夷社会最受尊崇的群体之一。
sentences.en_text: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.

sentences.cn_text: 遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学发展并不顺利。
sentences.en_text: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.

sentences.cn_text: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造爆发了抗议活动，这座巨型天文台有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认知。
sentences.en_text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity’s view of the cosmos.

sentences.cn_text: 争议焦点在于TMT计划选址莫纳克亚山，这座休眠火山被部分夏威夷人奉为「piko」（脐带），象征着夏威夷群岛与天界的连接。
sentences.en_text: At issue is the TMT’s planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.

sentences.cn_text: 但莫纳克亚山同时也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。
sentences.en_text: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world’s most powerful telescopes.

sentences.cn_text: 坐落于太平洋中的莫纳克亚山峰高耸于地球稠密大气层的大部分之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得无与伦比的清晰图像。
sentences.en_text: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea’s peak rises above the bulk of our planet’s dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.

sentences.cn_text: 反对在莫纳克亚山建造望远镜并非新鲜事。
sentences.en_text: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.

sentences.cn_text: 一小群但声音响亮的夏威夷人和环保人士长期以来一直将望远镜的存在视为对神圣土地的不敬，以及对这片曾经主权独立国土被占领历史的痛苦提醒。
sentences.en_text: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.

sentences.cn_text: 当前争议的部分责任应归咎于天文学家。
sentences.en_text: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.

sentences.cn_text: 在急于建造更大望远镜的过程中，他们忽略了科学并非理解世界的唯一途径。
sentences.en_text: In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world.

sentences.cn_text: 他们并未始终将保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统或其对岛屿居民的神圣性放在首位。
sentences.en_text: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea’s fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the islands’ inhabitants.

sentences.cn_text: 夏威夷文化并非历史遗存，而是一种正在经历复兴的鲜活文化。
sentences.en_text: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.

sentences.cn_text: 然而，科学同样有其文化史，其根源可追溯至文明之初。
sentences.en_text: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.

sentences.cn_text: 正是那种探寻地平线之外世界的好奇心，当初将早期波利尼西亚人带到夏威夷海岸，如今同样激励着天文学家探索天宇。
sentences.en_text: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii’s shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.

sentences.cn_text: 要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或禁止未来开发的呼声，忽视了这样一个现实：天文学与夏威夷文化都在追问我们是谁、我们从何而来、我们将去往何方这类根本性问题。
sentences.en_text: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.

sentences.cn_text: 这或许正是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛在回应某种原始召唤，以认识我们自己和我们真正的祖源之地。
sentences.en_text: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.

sentences.cn_text: 天文学界正在作出妥协，以改变其对莫纳克亚山的使用方式。
sentences.en_text: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.

sentences.cn_text: TMT选址经过精心考量，旨在最大限度减少望远镜在岛上的可见度，并避免对考古遗址和环境造成影响。
sentences.en_text: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope’s visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.

sentences.cn_text: 为限制莫纳克亚山上的望远镜数量，老旧望远镜将在其使用寿命结束后拆除，其场地将恢复为自然状态。
sentences.en_text: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.

sentences.cn_text: 没有理由不欢迎所有人来到莫纳克亚山，既拥抱自己的文化遗产，又研究星辰。
sentences.en_text: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.

sentences.cn_text: 第1段中莉莉乌欧卡拉尼女王的评论表明____。
sentences.en_text: Queen Liliuokalani’s remark in Paragraph 1 indicates ____

sentences.cn_text: 她对天文学历史作用的保守看法
sentences.en_text: her conservative view on the historical role of astronomy.

sentences.cn_text: 天文学在古代夏威夷社会的重要地位
sentences.en_text: the importance of astronomy in ancient Hawaiian society.

sentences.cn_text: 古代天文学令人惋惜的衰落
sentences.en_text: the regrettable decline of astronomy in ancient times.

sentences.cn_text: 她对其所处时代观星者成就的赞赏
sentences.en_text: her appreciation of star watchers’ feats in her time.

sentences.cn_text: 莫纳克亚山被视为理想的天文观测地点是因为____。
sentences.en_text: Mauna Kea is deemed as an ideal astronomical site due to ____

sentences.cn_text: 其地理特征
sentences.en_text: its geographical features.

sentences.cn_text: 其保护性周边环境
sentences.en_text: its protective surroundings.

sentences.cn_text: 其宗教意涵
sentences.en_text: its religious implications.

sentences.cn_text: 其现有的基础设施
sentences.en_text: its existing infrastructure.

sentences.cn_text: 部分当地人反对建造TMT，部分原因在于____。
sentences.en_text: The construction of the TMT is opposed by some locals partly because ____

sentences.cn_text: 这可能会破坏他们的精神生活
sentences.en_text: it may risk ruining their intellectual life.

sentences.cn_text: 这让他们想起一段屈辱的历史
sentences.en_text: it reminds them of a humiliating history.

sentences.cn_text: 他们的文化将失去复兴的机会
sentences.en_text: their culture will lose a chance of revival.

sentences.cn_text: 他们担心失去对莫纳克亚山的控制权
sentences.en_text: they fear losing control of Mauna Kea.

sentences.cn_text: 从第5段可以推断，当今天文学的进步____。
sentences.en_text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that progress in today’s astronomy ____

sentences.cn_text: 正在实现古代夏威夷人的梦想
sentences.en_text: is fulfilling the dreams of ancient Hawaiians.

sentences.cn_text: 有助于向世界传播夏威夷文化
sentences.en_text: helps spread Hawaiian culture across the world.

sentences.cn_text: 可能揭示夏威夷文化的起源
sentences.en_text: may uncover the origin of Hawaiian culture.

sentences.cn_text: 最终将缓和夏威夷人的敌意
sentences.en_text: will eventually soften Hawaiians’ hostility.

sentences.cn_text: 作者对选择莫纳克亚山作为TMT选址的态度是____。
sentences.en_text: The author’s attitude toward choosing Mauna Kea as the TMT site is one of ____

sentences.cn_text: 严厉批评
sentences.en_text: severe criticism.

sentences.cn_text: 被动接受
sentences.en_text: passive acceptance.

sentences.cn_text: 略有犹疑
sentences.en_text: slight hesitancy.

sentences.cn_text: 完全赞同
sentences.en_text: full approval.
